title: TWITTER R10 Pro current configuration index
notes: The current index from the TWITTER flagship-store listings explicitly names 骓特R10pro风暴骑士 and separately lists the R10Pro closed-wheel, electronic-shifting and other R10 Pro configurations. This establishes Storm Knight / White Knight as an R10 Pro configuration name rather than a separate platform. The lower-priced Storm Knight Shuntai build and the higher-priced closed-wheel WheelTop or Shimano build remain distinct complete-bike configurations; no generation number is inferred for Storm Knight.
